name: @blogLsp/client
description: Markdown editing assistant with LLM completions
author: hskksk

blogLsp.provider.markdownDescription: LLM provider to use. Supports OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and Anthropic.

blogLsp.model.markdownDescription: Model name for the selected provider. For Anthropic, e.g. 'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022'.

blogLsp.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Optional custom base URL for the provider. For Anthropic, defaults to https://api.anthropic.com when empty.

blogLsp.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the provider. You can reference environment variables like ${env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}.

blogLsp.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum tokens for responses (used for non gpt-5 models and Anthropic).

blogLsp.temperature.markdownDescription: Sampling temperature (used for non gpt-5 models and Anthropic).

blogLsp.numSuggestions.markdownDescription: Number of completion suggestions to generate.

blogLsp.language.markdownDescription: Primary language for prompts and style guidance.

blogLsp.privacy.scope.markdownDescription: Scope of text to send for completions.

blogLsp.enableStreaming.markdownDescription: Enable streaming responses when supported by the provider.

blogLsp.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout in milliseconds for LLM requests.

blogLsp.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: For gpt-5 series: set reasoning effort level.

blogLsp.verbosity.markdownDescription: For gpt-5 series: set verbosity level.

blogLsp.stylePrompt.markdownDescription: Optional multi-line style guide prompt to steer writing style.

blogLsp.completion.maxTextSuggestions.markdownDescription: Maximum number of text completion suggestions.

blogLsp.completion.triggerOnHeading.markdownDescription: Trigger completion suggestions when typing headings.
